description: Promote an existing release to another track WITHOUT re-uploading the bundle. WARNING, measured 2026-10-28: it creates an EMPTY draft release — it does NOT carry the artifact across, despite what this description used to claim. ALWAYS follow it with attach_artifact_to_release and check attach_verified, or start_rollout will refuse because the release has no artifact. Its new_release_id also echoes the SOURCE release id, so read the destination with get_track rather than trusting the echo. It does NOT publish; call start_rollout afterwards and confirm with the user first.

destination_track_id.description: Numeric track id to promote to. Call list_tracks first — the human alias ("production") is not accepted.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

release_id.description: Release id on the source track (from get_track/create_release). Pass this or version_code.

source_track_id.description: Numeric track id the release is on now. Call list_tracks first — the human alias ("internal") is not accepted.

version_code.description: Android version code of the build to promote; the release carrying it is looked up on the source track. Pass this or release_id.

name: promote_release
